plate.prompt:
stylized low-poly game art, in the style of the attached reference. big flat facets,
chunky bevelled shapes, flat colour planes with 2 or 3 values per colour, crisp dark
outlines. matte paint: no gloss, no reflection on any floor, no specular highlight,
no bloom. a few flat paint chips and rust patches, no noise texture. palette: cream,
teal, mustard, olive, rust, small orange lights, navy. warm key light from the upper
left, cool rim. space is near black navy with many small stars, no fog. not
photographic, not realistic, no depth of field.

outpost comms office interior, wide 16:9 plate, 2048 × 1152. orthographic cutaway at 42 degree azimuth and 29 degree elevation. rectangular raised floor, two walls at back and left, front open. left wall recedes from lower left to upper middle; back wall runs from upper middle toward right. cream walls with teal chunky beams, mustard pipes. large deep window fills left wall: near black navy space and many small stars, no planet. back wall contains a wide recessed console bay near the middle, a narrow recessed letter rack bay to its right, and a teal framed closed airlock at far right. console has chunky teal desk, small orange ansible display, two thick legs visibly touching the floor inside the bay. the letter rack contains a few cream envelopes in large square slots, anchored inside its wall bay, not floating outside it. broad clear matte muted cream-grey foreground floor, few large panels. calm wall card space. a tied cable and one rust patch at the edge. all furniture shares the room perspective. no people, text, interface or separate sprites. attached platform is the sole style anchor.
